charge_after_advance.name: Bounding Leap
charge_after_advance.description: Allows a unit to charge in the same turn it advanced.

charge_after_flee.description: Allows a unit to charge in a turn in which it fell back.

charge_impact.description: After this unit has charged, select one enemy unit withing engagement. Roll 1d6 : On a 4+, the target suffers 1 mortal wound

closest_target_penetration.description: When this unit makes a shooting attack at the closest eligible unit, add 1 to the weapon's penetration.

reactive_move.name: Skulking Horrors
reactive_move.description: Once per turn, after an enemy unit ends a move (normal, advance or retreat) within 9" of this unit, it can perform a normal move up to D6".

reroll_1_save_fight.description: During the fight phase, when this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the save rolls.

reroll_1_tohit_fight.description: During the fight phase, when this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the hit rolls.

reroll_1_towound.description: When this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the wound rolls.

cp_gain_on_objective.name: CP gain on controlled objective
cp_gain_on_objective.description: At the start of your Movement phase, for each objective marker you control that has one or more friendly non-battle-shocked units with this ability within range of it, roll one D6. If one or more of those rolls is a 4+, you gain 1CP. Le gain est GLOBAL : un seul CP quel que soit le nombre d'objectifs qui reussissent.

reroll_charge.description: When this unit makes a charge, it can reroll the charge roll.

reroll_towound_target_on_objective.description: When this unit makes an attack, it can reroll the wound rolls if the target unit is on an objective.

shoot_after_advance.description: Allows a unit to shoot in a turn in which it advanced.

shoot_after_flee.description: Allows a unit to shoot in a turn in which it fell back.

move_after_shooting.description: This unit can make a normal move up to 6" after shooting if it is not adjacent to an enemy unit. If it does so, this unit will not be able to charge until the end of the turn

adaptable_predators.description: Tyranid Warrior (range) : This unit can shoot and charge in a turn in which it fell back.

adaptable_predators_shoot_after_flee.name: Shoot After Flee (Adaptable Predators)
adaptable_predators_shoot_after_flee.description: Display rule for Adaptable Predators: allows shooting after fleeing.

adaptable_predators_charge_after_flee.name: Charge After Flee (Adaptable Predators)
adaptable_predators_charge_after_flee.description: Display rule for Adaptable Predators: allows charging after fleeing.

adrenalised_onslaught.description:
Tyranid Warrior (melee) : At the beginning of the fight phase, you can select one of the following ability to apply to this unit until the end of the phase :
 Aggression Imperative : During the fight phase, when this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the hit rolls.
 Preservation Imperative : During the fight phase, when this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the save rolls.

aggression_imperative.name: Aggression Imperative
aggression_imperative.description: During the fight phase, when this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the hit rolls.

preservation_imperative.name: Preservation Imperative
preservation_imperative.description: During the fight phase, when this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the save rolls.

cunning_hunters.description: Grey Hunters : This unit can shoot in a turn in which it fell back or advanced.

cunning_hunters_shoot_after_advance.name: Shoot After Advance (Cunning Hunters)
cunning_hunters_shoot_after_advance.description: Display rule for Cunning Hunters: allows shooting after advance.

cunning_hunters_shoot_after_flee.name: Shoot After Flee (Cunning Hunters)
cunning_hunters_shoot_after_flee.description: Display rule for Cunning Hunters: allows shooting after fleeing.

target_priority.description: This unit can shoot and charge in a turn in which it fell back.

oath_of_moment.name: Oath of Moment
oath_of_moment.description: Faction ability (08.04). At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army: it is your Oath of Moment target until the start of your next Command phase. Each time a model with this ability makes an attack that targets it, you can re-roll the Hit roll; and if you are using a Codex: Space Marines Detachment and your army includes no BLOOD ANGELS, DARK ANGELS, DEATHWATCH or SPACE WOLVES unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

waaagh.name: Waaagh!
waaagh.description: Faction ability (08.04). If your Army Faction is ORKS, once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can call a Waaagh!. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your army and: units from your army with this ability are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced; add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models from your army with this ability; models from your army with this ability have a 5+ invulnerable save.

targeted_intercession.description: Assault Interecessor : When this unit makes an attack, it can reroll rolls of 1 for the wound rolls. If the target is on an objective, it can reroll the wound rolls.

targeted_intercession_reroll_1_towound.name: Reroll 1 To Wound (Targeted Intercession)
targeted_intercession_reroll_1_towound.description: Display rule for Targeted Intercession: reroll 1 on wound rolls.

targeted_intercession_reroll_towound_tar.name: Reroll To Wound on Objective (Targeted Intercession)
targeted_intercession_reroll_towound_tar.description: Display rule for Targeted Intercession: reroll wound rolls against targets on objective.

deep_strike.name: Deep Strike
deep_strike.description: CORE (24.09): each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent's deployment zone.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: Before the battle, this unit can be attached to one eligible bodyguard unit (listed in CAN_LEAD) to form an attached unit (rules 19.01/24.22). Each bodyguard unit can have only one leader unit attached.

support.name: Support
support.description: Before the battle, this unit can be attached to one eligible bodyguard unit (listed in CAN_LEAD) to form an attached unit (rules 19.01/24.34). Each bodyguard unit can have only one support unit attached.

special_weapon.name: Special Weapon
special_weapon.description: Role marker: this model is the squad's special/heavy weapon bearer.

sergeant.name: Sergeant
sergeant.description: Role marker: this model is the squad leader (sergeant / pack leader).

feel_no_pain.name: Feel No Pain
feel_no_pain.description: CORE (24.12): each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a threshold+, that wound is not lost. Stored as rule_args.threshold (int 2-6).

deadly_demise.name: Deadly Demise
deadly_demise.description: CORE (24.08): when a model with this ability is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 6, each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds (X = rule_args.value, int or dice expression like 'D3'). Roll X separately per unit.

hit_roll_bonus_fight.name: Melee hit roll bonus
hit_roll_bonus_fight.description: Primitive A (chantier 06): this unit's melee weapons have +1 to hit rolls. Modelled by LOWERING the hit threshold, clamped to 2 (05.01: an unmodified 1 always fails). Carried by Might Is Right (Warboss).

wound_roll_bonus_fight.name: Melee wound roll bonus
wound_roll_bonus_fight.description: Primitive A (chantier 06): this unit's melee weapons have +1 to wound rolls. Modelled by LOWERING the wound threshold, clamped to 2 (05.02). Carried by Litany of Hate (Chaplain with Jump Pack).

charge_roll_bonus.name: Charge roll bonus
charge_roll_bonus.description: Primitive A (chantier 06): this unit has +1 to charge rolls (11.02). Applies to the 2D6 itself, not to an attack. Carried by Somethin' to Prove (Bigboss).

hit_roll_malus_suppressed.description: Primitive A (chantier 06): -1 to hit rolls while the unit is suppressed (Indiscriminate Detonations, Wartrakk). Pas d'obs_id, et c'est delibere : aucune datasheet ne PORTE cette regle, elle est l'effet du STATUT `suppressed`, deja observable par son propre registre (config/unit_statuses.json, obs_id 3). Lui donner un obs_id de capacite creerait un identifiant qu'aucune entite n'ecrirait jamais.

grant_weapon_rule_melee.name: Melee weapon rule grant (Sustained Hits 1)
grant_weapon_rule_melee.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : cette unite gagne [SUSTAINED HITS 1] sur ses armes de melee. Portee par Breakin' Heads (Bigboss).

grant_weapon_rule_melee_after_charge.name: Melee weapon rule grant after charge (Lethal Hits)
grant_weapon_rule_melee_after_charge.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : au tour ou cette unite a charge, ses armes de melee gagnent [LETHAL HITS]. Portee par Vanguard Assault (VanguardVeteranSquadJumpPack).

grant_weapon_rule_vs_designated_target.name: Ranged weapon rule grant vs designated target
grant_weapon_rule_vs_designated_target.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : les armes de tir matching weapon_code gagnent [BLAST 1] contre une cible non-MONSTER/VEHICLE designee. Portee par Overlapping Detonations (EradicatorHeavyBolter).

weapon_attacks_bonus_vs_keyword.name: Weapon attacks bonus vs keyword
weapon_attacks_bonus_vs_keyword.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : l'arme matching weapon_code gagne +attacks_bonus A si la cible est hors excluded_keywords. Portee par Dakkablitz (BigMekDakkarig).

weapon_attacks_bonus_vs_designated_targe.name: Weapon attacks bonus vs designated target
weapon_attacks_bonus_vs_designated_targe.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : les armes matching weapon_code gagnent +attacks_bonus A contre la cible designee. Portee par Hail of Bolts (Intercessor).

weapon_profile_scaling_by_model_count.name: Weapon profile scaling by model count
weapon_profile_scaling_by_model_count.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : pour chaque per_count figurines dans l'unite, +str_bonus a F et +dmg_bonus a D de l'arme weapon_code. A hazardous_threshold+ figurines, cette arme gagne [HAZARDOUS]. Portee par Waaagh! Energy (WeirdBoy).

melee_attacks_bonus_while_waaagh.name: Melee attacks bonus while Waaagh! active
melee_attacks_bonus_while_waaagh.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : tant que le Waaagh! est actif, les armes de melee de CE MODELE gagnent +attacks_bonus A. Portee par Da Biggest and da Best (Warboss).

once_per_battle_melee_buff.name: Once per battle melee buff
once_per_battle_melee_buff.description: Primitive B (chantier 06) : une fois par bataille en phase de corps a corps, les armes de melee de CE MODELE gagnent +attacks_bonus A et [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] jusqu'a la fin de la phase. Portee par Finest Hour (CaptainRelicShield).

feel_no_pain_vs_psychic.name: Feel No Pain vs Psychic
feel_no_pain_vs_psychic.description: Primitive C (chantier 06) : Feel No Pain X+ uniquement contre les attaques et capacites PSYCHIC (24.12). Conditionnel : l arme ou la source doit porter le mot-cle PSYCHIC. Porte par Psychic Hood (Librarian), seuil 4.

feel_no_pain_near_objective.name: Feel No Pain near objective
feel_no_pain_near_objective.description: Primitive C (chantier 06) : Feel No Pain X+ tant que le modele est a portee d un objectif (3") ou a 6" du centre du champ de bataille (24.12). Porte par Unbreakable Resolve (Ancient), seuil 4.

mortal_wounds_on_critical_wound.name: Mortal wounds on critical wound
mortal_wounds_on_critical_wound.description: Primitive D (chantier 06) : sur une blessure critique avec l arme designee (rule_args.weapon), inflige mw_dice blessures mortelles a la cible (fin de sequence). Non VEHICLE uniquement. Porte par Hold Still and Say Aargh (PainBoy, 'urty Syringe, D6 MW).

mortal_wounds_on_fight_activation.name: Mortal wounds on fight activation
mortal_wounds_on_fight_activation.description: Primitive D (chantier 06) : a la selection en combat, lance D6 : 4-5 -> D3 BM, 6 -> mw_on_6 BM sur un ennemi engage au choix du joueur (decision agent mortal_wounds_target). Porte par Exhortation de Rage (ChaplainJumpPack), mw_on_6=3.

secure_objective_on_control.name: Secure objective on control
secure_objective_on_control.description: Primitive E (chantier 06) : en fin de phase de commandement, si l unite controle un objectif, cet objectif est securise pour ce joueur — l adversaire doit avoir STRICTEMENT plus d OC pour le reprendre (14.03). Textes identiques dans les deux PDF : une seule regle, deux declarations (Get da Good Bitz / Boyz, Objective Secured / Intercessor).

oc_bonus.name: OC bonus
oc_bonus.description: Primitive E (chantier 06) : ajoute oc_bonus a la caracteristique OC de chaque figurine de l unite pour le controle d objectif (14.02). Porte par Relic Banner (Ancient), oc_bonus=1.
